subject: Permission request: Divine Mercy Novena from the Diary of St. Faustina in a free Catholic prayer app
body:
Dear Marian Press,

North Boutique Studios Ltd. publishes John 1:1, a free Catholic Bible and prayer app for iPhone, iPad and
Android. We would like to include the Novena to the Divine Mercy (Diary of Saint Maria Faustina Kowalska,
nos. 1209–1229) in its English translation, exactly as you publish it, with your copyright notice shown beside
it.

- Use: the nine days of the novena, shown in the app's novena guide, available offline, with a short source
  line and a link to your edition. The text is not changed.
- The app is free, with no ads and no account. One optional purchase unlocks a library of Church Fathers; the
  novena is free and not part of it.
- Platforms and markets: iOS and Android, worldwide, English.
- Audience: about 120 new downloads every 90 days and about 330 existing users (October 2026).
- Organisation: North Boutique Studios Ltd., 846 Roulston St, London, ON N6H 0E4, Canada.

We would be grateful for your permission and your terms, including any fee and the exact credit line you
require. If the Congregation of the Sisters of Our Lady of Mercy must also approve, we would be glad to write
to them as well.
